en.headline: 7 own commits, 5 automated, 2 issues opened, 1 discussion started
en.summary: On 2026-10-16, the user made **7 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, plus 5 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The own commits in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` were all documentation work: adding an `AGENTS.md` and noting the origin remote, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge section from Git/GitHub to broader topics, archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth and Windows path pitfalls, archiving oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode hands-on notes, and making knowledge supplementation a default action with architecture adjustable to content. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. The user opened 2 issues in `anomalyco/opencode`: #55785 about `mimo-v2.6-flash` and `mimo-v2.5` advertising image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image with 400, and #55772 requesting a way to run the CLI shipped with the Windows desktop build. The user also started discussion #4982 in `openchamber/openchamber` titled "Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients" in the Ideas category. No replies, stars, or state changes were recorded, and no section was truncated.
